Name: membership
The two hypotheses, or the target: a record $z$ is in an honest dataset, or it is not

Name: source
The two hypotheses, or the target: $z$ is with honest client $i$ and $z'$ with honest client $j$, or the two are swapped, so the union and every size stay fixed

Name: property
The two hypotheses, or the target: the honest data come from a distribution with a property, or without it

Name: record
The two hypotheses, or the target: a record of an honest dataset, within a distance

Name: attribute
The two hypotheses, or the target: one feature or the label of a record whose other features are known

Name: model
The two hypotheses, or the target: the parameters or the behavior of a model that is an honest input

Name: query
The two hypotheses, or the target: the query of an honest querier

Name: targeted
The two hypotheses, or the target: honest outputs whose model maps chosen inputs to chosen labels

Name: untargeted
The two hypotheses, or the target: honest outputs whose model has accuracy below a level

Name: delivery
The two hypotheses, or the target: the honest parties receive no output
